reasons.text: Because you were my very first friend.
Because you never let me feel alone in a crowded room.
Because you remember things about me I've forgotten myself.
Because your hugs fix things words can't.
Because you laugh at my worst jokes anyway.
Because you tell me the truth, even when it's hard to hear.
Because you somehow manage to make boring days fun.
Because you cover for me without even asking why.
Because you notice when I go quiet.
Because you still know exactly how to make me smile.
Because you never made me feel like the annoying one.
Because you're the loudest one cheering for me.
Because you kept every silly secret I ever told you.
Because you show up, even at 2am, no questions asked.
Because you make our home feel like home.
Because you let me borrow your things without complaining (mostly).
Because you were brave first, so I knew I could be too.
Because you still remember our childhood inside jokes.
Because you never let anyone else talk badly about me.
Because your advice is annoyingly always right.
Because you make ordinary car rides feel like an adventure.
Because you send me memes at exactly the right moment.
Because you never gave up on me, even when I gave up on myself.
Because even when we fight, you're still my sister.
Because you taught me what unconditional love looks like.
Because you make family dinners bearable.
Because you never once made me feel small.
Because your voice on the phone still calms me down.
Because you know exactly which songs remind us of home.
Because you're the keeper of all our family stories.
Because you always save me a seat.
Because you're proud of me even for the small things.
Because you make me a better, kinder person.
Because you never let distance change how close we feel.
Because you understand my silences as well as my words.
Because you always have snacks hidden somewhere.
Because you're the first person I want to tell good news.
Because you're also the first person I call with bad news.
Because you make our parents laugh like no one else can.
Because you're patient with me even when I don't deserve it.
Because you remember birthdays and small anniversaries no one else does.
Because your room always felt safer than mine.
Because you never let me walk into anything unprepared.
Because you still fight for the last piece of dessert with me.
Because you make holidays feel like holidays.
Because you never let a fight turn into forever.
Because you're the reason I believe in loyalty.
Because you cry at movies just as much as I do.
Because you always know when I'm pretending to be okay.
Because halfway through, and you're still the best part of my story.
Because you make me feel brave enough to try new things.
Because you never once made our differences a competition.
Because you keep every photo, even the embarrassing ones.
Because you're my built-in best friend I never had to choose.
Because you always have my back in front of other people.
Because you make long drives home feel shorter.
Because you never let me forget where I come from.
Because you're the reason I know what real support feels like.
Because you still tease me the exact same way you did as kids.
Because you make chaos feel a little more manageable.
Because you never make me explain myself twice.
Because your kindness to strangers makes me proud to be your sibling.
Because some memories wouldn't exist without you.
Because you always pick up, even mid-argument with someone else.
Because you make me want to be someone you can look up to.
Because you never let me eat the last snack alone.
Because you remember our grandparents' stories exactly the way they told them.
Because you're the reason our house was never quiet.
Because you still defend childhood-me in every family story.
Because you make me laugh until it actually hurts.
Because you never made growing up feel lonely.
Because you notice the little changes in me before anyone else does.
Because your opinion is the one I actually want, even unasked.
Because you're the softest place to land after a hard day.
Because you always make room for me in your plans.
Because you're honest about my flaws and love me anyway.
Because you never let me feel replaceable.
Because you still remember the nicknames only we use.
Because you make even grocery runs feel like an event.
Because you never let my bad days become bad weeks.
Because you fight with me about nothing and forgive me for everything.
Because you carry pieces of our childhood I've forgotten.
Because you show up for the people I love too.
Because you never let me apologize for taking up space.
Because you make traditions feel worth keeping.
Because your texts always land exactly when I need them.
Because you never once made me feel like a burden.
Because you know my worst habits and stay anyway.
Because you make our family feel like a team.
Because you still remember how I take my tea or coffee.
Because you're the loudest laugh in every family photo.
Because you never let me lose myself in comparison.
Because you make it easy to come home.
Because you're proof that some bonds were never a choice, just a gift.
Because you still stand up for me the way you did when we were kids.
Because you never let silence turn into distance.
Because you make me want to be a better sibling too.
Because our story has your fingerprints on every page.
Because after everything, you're still my favorite person to annoy.

I don't really need 100 reasons.
You're my sister.
That's enough.
